identity.name: MR-G MRG-B5000

movement.caliber: Tough Solar quartz module with Multi-Band 6 and Bluetooth

case.material: Ti64 titanium case, DAT55G titanium bracelet

identity.one_liner: MR-G's titanium and Cobarion take on the 1983 G-Shock square, built to watchmaking finishing tolerances above the steel GMW-B5000 and GW-5000U.

narrative.story: The MRG-B5000 applies MR-G's materials and finishing — a Ti64 titanium case, a Cobarion cobalt-chrome bezel rated four times harder than titanium, and a DAT55G titanium bracelet — to the DW-5000C square that started G-Shock in 1983. Casio launched it in 2022 at the top of the metal-square lineage, running the same Tough Solar, Multi-Band 6, and Bluetooth spec as the steel GMW-B5000 but assembled to MR-G's tighter tolerances.
narrative.collector_notes: Two standard finishes exist: the titanium-carbide-coated MRG-B5000D at $3,500 and the full black-DLC MRG-B5000B with gold-tone accents at $4,000; limited colorway releases have followed at higher prices.
